audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart disagreed with the content layer on all seven rows: full read LeBlanc, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, Skill, Skill, Skill while win[] read Akali x4, LeBlanc at 6, Akali, Akali.
audit.why: win[] matches packet.levelChart and the 51.03% Akali win rate, and it matches the real shape of the lane: Akali presses pre-6, concedes level 6 to Mimic, takes it back on items.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side realigned to win[N] as one group, with every phase why rewritten to its new owner.

audit.why: Level 6 genuinely is her spike — Mimic is a 45s at rank 1 that repeats a basic spell — and the first item is the reclaim. The existing spike structure was right; only the mechanics inside it were wrong.
audit.corrected: Spike text regrounded on Mimic's 45s and on the 15s Distortion gap, rather than on vague 'chain-CC'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The root was attributed to the wrong ability throughout — 'her Sigil root', 'Shroud dodges her Sigil root', 'bait her Sigil root'.
audit.why: Sigil of Malice (Q) is a 700-range mark lasting 3.5 seconds that another ability detonates; it does not root. The root is Ethereal Chains (E), 925 range, and crucially it only roots if the target is STILL shackled 1.5 seconds after the chain lands. That 1.5-second grace is the single decisive interaction in this matchup and the page never mentioned it: walk out of range and neither the root nor the Sigil detonation happens.
audit.corrected: Every 'Sigil root' replaced with Ethereal Chains and its 1.5s break window; Sigil described correctly as a 3.5s mark that needs a second spell.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Distortion but gave no cooldown, only the 4s return window.
audit.why: The actionable pair is that the return cast expires after 4 seconds while the ability itself is 15s at rank 1 — so the lapse of the return leaves her with an 11-second hole and no exit.
audit.corrected: Distortion 15s/10s plus 4s return, Ethereal Chains 14s at rank 1 with the 1.5s break, Mimic 45s — all written in and used as the commit trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mirror Image was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Below 40% health she turns invisible for 1 second and leaves a clone for up to 8 seconds. Against an execute ultimate this decides whether your R lands on her or on nothing, and it is exactly the moment an Akali commits.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.carry and loading — finish her above 40% or expect to chase a clone.

notes: Main correction is an ability-attribution error the packet did not flag: the page called the root 'her Sigil root' in three places. Sigil of Malice (Q) is a 3.5-second mark that a second ability detonates; the root is Ethereal Chains (E), and it only roots if the target is still shackled 1.5 seconds later — that grace window is the decisive interaction and was missing entirely. Mirror Image (below 40% HP: 1s invisibility plus an 8s clone) was also absent and matters directly to an execute ultimate; added to breakdown.carry and loading. Full-layer chart disagreed with content on all seven rows and was realigned to win[]/packet. Ratings left as they stand (7/7/7/7/6/6/6) — I could not establish the scale's polarity from the brief and did not want to guess. | COHERENCE: 1 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it.
